_doc: Banned-terms list for the content lint (design/sim/content-lint.mjs today; the developer's build lint later). Any hit fails the build unless the string's id is in allow[] with a reason. Owned by the Game Designer.

match.fields: every string in design/content.json except keys starting with '_' and keys named visualHook, id, src, avatar, icon; also every value in ux/ui-strings.json and every facts[].aboutHe

categories.why: October 7, the hostages, fallen soldiers and their families are never jokes or game elements (brief). Bar, 2026-09-29: no mention of October 7 anywhere in the game, direct or by date. The lint also scans ux/ui-strings.json and facts[].aboutHe, and rejects the date written as 7.10 / 07.10 / 7/10 (27.10, the election date, is fine).
Soldiers, uniforms, reserve duty, weapons, war; nothing that looks military sits near 'סבב' (brief; pitch §1).
Gaza, the 2018 Qatari cash, Iran war, named enemies (pitch §2.4; round 2 'Still out').
Private individuals and flagged/off people (round 2; pitch §2.9-2.10; fact sheet 'Stay away from').
No state emblems, party logos, or messaging-app branding (brief; UX §4.3).
Satire, not a campaign: no 'vote for', no party links (brief).
Their current bits are theirs (round 2 'Still out').

reviewTerms._doc: Not banned, but every hit needs a human read: a group of people must never be the punchline (brief).

rules.rule: A digit within 3 words of מנדט/מנדטים/סקר/סקרים/מוביל/מובילה/אחוז החסימה fails unless the string is tagged poll_like:true.

rules.why: 'סבב' alone means a round of fighting (pitch §1).
rules.rule: 'סבב' must be followed by 'בחירות' or 'הבחירות', except in the title phrase 'עוד סבב' and in 'סבבי בחירות'. 'סבב' never shares a string with a military-category term.

rules.why: Real quotes are exact and marked (brief); invented speech of a real person never sits in quote marks in the ticker.
rules.rule: A ticker string that names a real person and contains quotation marks must carry src with a [Q] fact, or reportedSpeech. Chat bubbles are exempt (they are the character's invented voice in a fictional chat, deck §E).

rules.why: Anything presented as real stays inside the fact sheet (brief).
rules.rule: Every src id exists in design/facts.json; facts with usedIn == [] are reported.

rules.why: Sevev 9 has no emoji; a missing glyph draws a box (TA objection).
rules.rule: See glyphs: every character is ASCII, Hebrew, a font character, or an approved pictogram.

glyphs._doc: The Sevev 9 bitmap font has no colour emoji and no fallback (TA objection, 2026-09-28). Every character in a non-underscore string of design/content.json must be printable ASCII, a Hebrew letter, one of fontNonAscii, or one of the 12 approved pictograms (drawn by the 2D Artist as 7-row glyphs). Emoji stay allowed only in share texts and OG tags, which are UX's and not drawn by the font. fontNonAscii mirrors pipeline/od-sevev/font/sevev9.glyphs on 2026-09-28; the TA build's coverage check stays authoritative.

allow.why: Her own quote [Q] from the fact sheet (brief round 2), reported speech, poll_like:true, hidden in the blackout. Never mention the covert officer.

About page (facts.json aboutHe, always public): her own verified term [Q] (Walla, Ynet), in quote marks as on her card. The public line carries no שב״כ and no seat number (poll rule in the blackout). Never mention the covert officer.
